name: cost-ledger
description: Records what every chat costs, across projects and, if you like, across devices, so you can see where your usage goes. It only observes and makes no model calls.

plan.title: Subscription
plan.description: Your plan, for the subscription month in /ledger limits. none: no subscription. max5 and max20 are old names and switch to max and ultra. Also /ledger plan.

billingDay.title: Billing day
billingDay.description: Day of the month your subscription renews (1 to 31).

planPrice.title: Monthly price ($)
planPrice.description: 0: list price (Pro $20, Max $100, Ultra $200). Team and Enterprise need a price here.

dayYellow.title: Yellow from ($ per day)
dayYellow.description: Days at or above this total (chats and mods) turn yellow in the history.

dayRed.title: Red from ($ per day)
dayRed.description: Days at or above this total turn red.

keepDays.title: Keep chats (days)
keepDays.description: Chats with no new cost for this long are deleted at the next /ledger.

syncFolder.title: Sync folder
syncFolder.description: Shared folder (e.g. Google Drive) to merge your devices. Only amounts and project folder names are written. Empty: off. Also /ledger sync.

deviceName.title: Device name
deviceName.description: Name of this device in the sync, up to 30 characters. Empty: Device and an ID.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /ledger language.
